3. *Every one of those points leaves exactly one trace.* a.md pins the ledger's granularity to one row per decision — not per run, not per token. Combined with the other two, that means the decision points the code-owned loop creates, and the ask/allow outcomes the gate produces, are each individually auditable after the fact.

The through-line is auditable, conservative agency: a deterministic driver, a default of asking when in doubt, and a one-to-one record of every choice made.
